verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source memory engine, but no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. Running locally with no account, and a `cognee-cli demo` that works on a machine with no network access, are adjacent deployment behaviors. They are not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
